metadata.title: Tim Patrick - Remains No. 2 option
metadata.description: Patrick is set to continue as the No. 2 wide receiver for the Jets' game against the Patriots on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Adonai Mitchell (finger) remains sidelined for Week 6, leaving Patrick as the No. 2 option behind Garrett Wilson. The wide receiver caught two of his three targets for 26 yards in the team's Week 5 win over the Browns. Patrick played 93 percent of the Jets' offensive snaps in his first game back from a groin injury.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick catches two passes in Week 5
metadata.description: Tim Patrick caught two of his three targets for 26 yards in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
metadata.analysis: After being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week after recovering from a groin injury, Patrick finished second on the Jets in receiving in the close win. He will not be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 6 against the Patriots.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick - Activated from injured reserve
metadata.description: The Jets activated Patrick (groin) from injured reserve Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Patrick also doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Browns, suggesting he's 100 percent healthy. His role remains unclear behind Garrett Wilson. Isaiah Williams and Sterling Shepard have been handling Nos. 2 and 3 receiver duties, respectively, the last couple weeks due to Adonai Mitchell (finger) being sidelined.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick - Questionable to return from IR
metadata.description: Patrick (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns.
metadata.analysis: A full practice participant all week, Patrick could be brought back from injured reserve to help fill in for Adonai Mitchell, who is out for a second straight game with a finger injury. Isaiah Williams filled in as the No. 2 wide receiver last week, with Sterling Shepard called up from the practice squad as the No. 3. If Patrick is activated Friday or Saturday, he could jump into the rotation.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick (groin) logs full practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Tim Patrick was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Patrick had his practice window opened on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is activated.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick - Cleared to practice
metadata.description: The Jets designated Patrick (groin) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, John Pullano of the team's official site reports.
metadata.analysis: The transaction opens the veteran wide receiver's 21-day practice window. he was a full participant in Wednesday's session, and if he can maintain that level of activity Thursday and Friday, Patrick will have a good shot at being activated from IR ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns. The Jets could have a need for Patrick to fill out their receiving corps, as Adonai Mitchell (finger) is still being viewed as week-to-week and appears unlikely to play Sunday.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick (groin) has practice window opened
metadata.description: The Jets opened the practice window for WR Tim Patrick.
metadata.analysis: Patrick will return to practice this week. He will likely remain off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick - Moved to IR
metadata.description: The Jets placed Patrick (groin) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Patrick was ruled out ahead of Sunday's contest after Friday's practice. The wide receiver's groin injury seems to be lingering, so the 32-year-old will spend some time on IR. Patrick will be eligible to return from IR after four games, meaning Isaiah Williams and Arian Smith will likely see a greater share of reserve opportunities with the Jets' wide receiver corps.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick Placed on Injured Reserve
metadata.description: New York Jets wide receiver Tim Patrick (groin) is being placed on injured reserve, according to Zack Rosenblatt. Patrick was already ruled out for Sunday's opener against Tennessee after missing practice Thursday and Friday, and now he will be sidelined for at least four games. The veteran signed with New York in May after spending last season with Jacksonville, where he caught 15 passes for 187 yards and three touchdowns across 16 games. Patrick was buried on a Jets depth chart that already includes Garrett Wilson, Adonai Mitchell, Omar Cooper Jr., Isaiah Williams and Arian Smith, so there was not much fantasy value here even before the injury. His absence could create a few extra snaps elsewhere in the receiver rotation, but there is no obvious waiver-wire winner from this move. Patrick can be left on waivers in standard leagues while he works his way back.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick - Won't play Sunday
metadata.description: Patrick (groin) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
metadata.analysis: Patrick did not practice this week and subsequently will be unable to participate in Sunday's regular-season opener. The wide receiver has been dealing with a recent groin injury. It is unclear when Patrick will be able to return to the field and if additional time must be missed.

metadata.title: Tim Patrick (groin) out for Week 1
metadata.description: Tim Patrick (groin) won't be available for Sunday's season opener.
metadata.analysis: Patrick has yet to return to practice, so it's no surprise that he will not play in Week 1. The veteran receiver signed with the Jets this offseason after catching 15 passes with three touchdowns over 16 games for the Jaguars last season.
